microtheory.name: semantics_linguistics
microtheory.definition: Meaning in language. How forms map to concepts + truth conditions. Frege/Russell/Tarski formal semantics, Montague grammar, situation semantics, frame semantics (Fillmore), prototype theory (Rosch), distributional semantics, conceptual semantics. Substrate analogue: the mapping from substrate's lexical realizations to its Concept graph.

concepts.name: sense_reference
concepts.definition: Frege 1892. Sense (Sinn) = mode of presentation; Reference (Bedeutung) = what's picked out. 'Morning star' + 'evening star' have different senses, same reference (Venus). Substrate analogue: substrate's name vs Concept distinction.

concepts.name: intension_extension
concepts.definition: Intension = meaning; Extension = set of things referred to. 'Renate' intension = creature with kidney; extension = same as 'cordate' (heart-bearer). Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept definition vs Concept instances.

concepts.name: truth_conditions
concepts.definition: What the world must be like for a sentence to be true. Wittgenstein's Tractatus. Substrate analogue: substrate's predicate's basin condition.

concepts.name: compositionality
concepts.definition: Frege's principle. Meaning of complex expression determined by meanings of parts + how they combine. Substrate analogue: substrate's Term-tree evaluation = compositional.

concepts.name: lexical_semantics
concepts.definition: Word meaning. Sense relations, polysemy, vagueness, ambiguity. Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept attribute semantics.

concepts.name: polysemy
concepts.definition: One word, multiple related senses. 'Foot' = body part / mountain base / unit of measure. Substrate analogue: substrate's multi-edge Concept.

concepts.name: homonymy
concepts.definition: Same form, unrelated meanings. 'Bank' = financial vs river. Substrate analogue: substrate's coincident lexical realizations.

concepts.name: synonymy
concepts.definition: Different forms, same meaning. 'Begin' / 'commence'. Usually only partial. Substrate analogue: substrate's parallel-edge Concepts.

concepts.name: antonymy
concepts.definition: Opposed meanings. Gradable (hot/cold), complementary (alive/dead), reverse (buy/sell). Substrate analogue: substrate's anti-correlated Concepts.

concepts.name: hyponymy
concepts.definition: Subset relation. Robin is a hyponym of bird. Substrate analogue: substrate's genlMt-like Concept hierarchy.

concepts.name: meronymy
concepts.definition: Part-whole. Wheel is a meronym of car. Substrate analogue: substrate's part-of edge.

concepts.name: formal_semantics
concepts.definition: Montague 1973. Semantics via logic + type theory + lambda calculus. Compositional bottom-up meaning derivation. Substrate analogue: substrate's typed compositional evaluation.

concepts.name: model_theoretic_semantics
concepts.definition: Tarski 1933. Sentence interpreted relative to a model (domain + relations). Truth value computed compositionally. Substrate analogue: substrate's Term evaluated against graph state.

concepts.name: possible_worlds_semantics
concepts.definition: Kripke 1959. Necessity = true in all worlds; possibility = true in some. Substrate analogue: substrate's modal Mt-state evaluation.

concepts.name: quantifier_scope
concepts.definition: Every student read some book — universal over existential (each student potentially different book) or vice versa. Ambiguity. Substrate analogue: substrate's nested quantification.

concepts.name: frame_semantics
concepts.definition: Fillmore 1976. Meaning structured by knowledge frames. 'Buy' invokes commercial-transaction frame with buyer, seller, goods, money. FrameNet. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-as-frame structure.

concepts.name: prototype_theory
concepts.definition: Rosch 1973. Categories organized around prototypes. Robin is a more prototypical bird than penguin. Graded membership. Substrate analogue: substrate's category-with-graded-membership.

concepts.name: image_schema
concepts.definition: Johnson 1987, Lakoff. Embodied abstract structures (container, path, force) underlying meaning. Substrate analogue: substrate's primitive grounding structures.

concepts.name: conceptual_metaphor
concepts.definition: Lakoff + Johnson 1980. Abstract concepts structured by mapping from concrete domains. ARGUMENT IS WAR. Substrate analogue: substrate's analogical_transfer faculty.

concepts.name: construction_meaning
concepts.definition: Goldberg. Constructions carry meaning independent of constituent words. 'X V'd Y to oblivion' is X caused-by-V-ing Y to be obliterated. Substrate analogue: substrate's compositional Mt-pattern meaning.

concepts.name: distributional_hypothesis
concepts.definition: Harris 1954, Firth 1957. Words with similar distributions have similar meanings. Foundation of word embeddings. Substrate analogue: substrate's distributional Concept-similarity.

concepts.name: word_embedding
concepts.definition: Dense vector representation. Mikolov 2013 (word2vec), Pennington 2014 (GloVe). Captures distributional + analogical relationships. Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept-as-feature-vector.

concepts.name: vector_space_semantics
concepts.definition: Words as vectors. Similarity = cosine. Analogies via vector arithmetic (king - man + woman ≈ queen). Substrate analogue: substrate's high-dimensional Concept embedding.

concepts.name: presupposition
concepts.definition: Background assumption taken for granted. 'The king of France is bald' presupposes there is a king. Substrate analogue: substrate's required-context concept.

concepts.name: entailment
concepts.definition: Logical consequence. 'John runs' entails 'John moves'. Substrate analogue: substrate's rule chain.

concepts.name: implicature
concepts.definition: Inferred but not entailed. 'Some students passed' implicates not all. Substrate analogue: substrate's default-inference.

concepts.name: lexical_aspect
concepts.definition: Vendler 1957. State, activity, accomplishment, achievement. 'Know' is stative; 'build a house' is accomplishment. Substrate analogue: substrate's temporal-shape concept attribute.

rules.name: compositionality_constrains_meaning_derivation
rules.head: the substrate computes the meaning of a complex expression
rules.body: the result is a function of constituent meanings + composition rules — not arbitrary. Frege. Substrate's Term-tree evaluation honours this.

rules.name: context_resolves_lexical_ambiguity
rules.head: the substrate encounters a polysemous word
rules.body: the surrounding context selects the contextually-appropriate sense. Substrate's context-conditioned Concept selection.

rules.name: frame_invocation_enables_inference
rules.head: the substrate recognises a frame-evoking expression
rules.body: the full frame structure becomes available for inference. 'Buy' brings buyer/seller/goods/money. Substrate's Mt-as-frame invocation.

rules.name: distributional_similarity_predicts_substitutability
rules.head: two words have similar distributional profiles
rules.body: they are similar in meaning + often substitutable. Substrate's distributional Concept comparison.

rules.name: implicature_arises_from_cooperation_violation
rules.head: the substrate hears 'some students passed'
rules.body: Gricean Quantity maxim says speakers say as much as relevant — therefore not all passed. Substrate's Gricean inference.
